protocol: Recovered v1 U1-U8; latest direct scope; SITREP OUT
metric: R=(F_B-F_C)/F_B if F_B>0; target>=0.5; N=8; no candidate regression
routes: Any visible current Home route. Baseline Documents via More tools then Documents; Timeline via tab then phase; reminder via Next Action then header. Scroll/focus not navigation activations.

milestones.title: Initial Planning & Medical Documentation

tasks.text: Attend Initial TAP briefing
Complete Individual Transition Plan (ITP) with commander
Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record.
Follow up on current conditions, referrals, and specialist appointments; keep your service treatment records current

Research VR&E (Chapter 31) — vocational rehab benefits at 10%+ disability rating (priority at 20%+). It interacts with your GI Bill and the choice matters — understand both before you elect. Ask a VSO
Review military service records for accuracy (OMPF)
Research post-separation state: income tax, property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet benefits
Begin networking — LinkedIn profile, veteran groups, mentors
Get professional headshot — Portraits for Patriots offers FREE headshots for military (see Resources → TAP+)

milestones.reminder: Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record. Also: research VR&E (Ch. 31) — if you qualify, understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you choose, because the election affects both.

milestones.title: Benefits, Claims & Medical Follow-Up

tasks.text: Continue medical documentation — follow up on ALL referrals and specialist appointments
Keep service treatment records current; follow up on active referrals and document current conditions
If eligible: apply for VR&E (Chapter 31) NOW — vocational rehab for service-connected veterans. Understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you elect — the choice matters
Research VA disability claim process and BDD program (opens at 180 days)
Attend TAP workshops — not all TAPs are equal, supplement with outside resources (see Resources → TAP+)
Research GI Bill eligibility and transfer options — remember VR&E comes FIRST if eligible
Verify SGLI to VGLI conversion timeline

milestones.reminder: BDD opens at 180 days. Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA evaluates each claimed condition using the evidence of record. Consider VR&E (Ch. 31) before spending GI Bill months if you qualify — the two interact and the election matters. Ask a VSO which fits your plan.

milestones.title: Career Targeting & Gap Analysis

tasks.text: Run MOS through O*NET Crosswalk — identify top 3 civilian job matches (Pathway tab)
Complete Gap Analysis — compare your skills to target job requirements (Pathway → Step 2)
Choose your path: college degree, certs/trades, or SkillBridge (Pathway → Step 3)
Research certs & credentials on DOD COOL — many are FREE on active duty
Map your income stack: VA comp + GI Bill BAH + work programs (Pathway → Step 4)
Apply through your service-specific SkillBridge or Career Skills Program process after confirming your maximum days and approval authority.
Apply for ACP mentorship — FREE year-long 1-on-1 with Fortune 500 professionals (acp-usa.org)
Register on 50 Strong — FREE on-demand mentoring, employer connects, and job board (50-strong.us)
Contact vet-ready employers with gap closure programs (Pathway → Step 5)

milestones.reminder: Run your crosswalk. Run your gap analysis. Choose your path. GET A MENTOR NOW — ACP and 50 Strong are free and connect you with civilians who've hired vets. One conversation can change your trajectory.

milestones.title: BDD Filing & Financial Operations

tasks.text: SUBMIT BDD claim (Benefits Delivery at Discharge) — 180-90 day window is NOW
Be available for VA C&P exams within 45 days of filing
Keep service treatment records current and complete before separation
Build post-separation budget (no BAH/BAS)
Determine state of residence for tax purposes
Research VA home loan pre-approval
Open/verify civilian bank accounts
Review TSP rollover options
Secure housing at post-separation location

milestones.reminder: BDD WINDOW IS OPEN. Submit your claim NOW (180-90 days pre-sep). Be available for VA exams within 45 days of filing. Keep your service treatment records current and complete.

milestones.title: Administrative & Legal Closeout

tasks.text: Complete DD214 worksheet — verify every line
Schedule separation physical (VA C&P exam may satisfy this — check with medical)
Verify all awards, decorations, schools on record
Set up VA healthcare enrollment
Update DEERS for dependents
Finalize SBP elections (if retiring)

milestones.reminder: Your DD214 is your most important document. Verify every entry. Errors are costly.

milestones.title: Final Preparations & Outprocessing

tasks.text: Complete installation outprocessing checklist
Turn in all CIF/IIF (unit supply) and organizational equipment
Obtain 10+ certified copies of DD214
Verify final pay / leave sellback
Set up TRICARE transition (TAMP if eligible / CHCBP)
Confirm VA disability rating status

milestones.reminder: Get 10+ certified copies of your DD214. You will need them for everything.

milestones.title: First 90 Days as a Veteran

tasks.text: Register with VA healthcare system
Apply for state veteran benefits — property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet bonuses
File for unemployment (UCX) if applicable
Connect with local veteran service organizations
Verify GI Bill enrollment / housing allowance
Establish primary care provider
Get your America the Beautiful Pass — FREE National Parks & Federal Lands access for all veterans (see Vet Perks tab)
Get veteran designation on driver's license — free in most states, proves status without carrying DD214
Join a veteran community — Team RWB, The Mission Continues, Team Rubicon, Next 18 (free golf & wellness camps), local VFW or American Legion post. Don't isolate.
Read the MINDSET tab — The Drop hits at months 1-3. Know the signs. Build structure. Ask for help if you need it.

milestones.reminder: You earned these benefits. Don't leave anything on the table. And be ready for The Drop — the loss of identity, structure, and purpose hits harder than anyone warns you. Build your new routine, connect with other vets, and don't isolate. See Resources → Mindset.

documents.name: DD214 (Member-4 Copy)
documents.notes: Get 10+ certified copies. Required for nearly all veteran benefits.

documents.name: VA Disability Rating Letter
documents.notes: Download from VA.gov (Records → VA letters).

documents.name: Military Medical Records (Complete)
documents.notes: Request from MTF. Include dental. Takes 30-90 days.

documents.name: Service Record (OMPF)
documents.notes: Verify all entries via iPERMS or branch equivalent.

documents.name: Joint Services Transcript (JST)
documents.notes: Download from jst.doded.mil. Maps training to ACE credits.

documents.name: VMET Document
documents.notes: Translates military experience to civilian terms.

documents.name: TSP Account Statement
documents.notes: Current balance, fund allocations, beneficiary info.

documents.name: SGLI/VGLI Documentation
documents.notes: SGLI to VGLI conversion within 240 days of separation.

documents.name: VA Certificate of Eligibility (COE)
documents.notes: For VA home loan. Request via VA.gov.

documents.name: GI Bill Statement of Benefits
documents.notes: Verify months remaining, transfer status.

documents.name: Security Clearance Verification
documents.notes: Clearance status and investigation dates.

documents.name: Awards/Decoration Certificates
documents.notes: Physical copies of all awards.

reminders.title: Initiate Individual Transition Plan (ITP)
reminders.brief: Sit down with your commander and establish your ITP. This is the foundation — everything builds from here.
items: Schedule ITP meeting with chain of command
Attend initial TAP briefing
Request copies of ORB/SRB (or branch equivalent) and review for accuracy
Pull OMPF and verify all service records
reminders.deadline: No hard deadline — but every day you wait compresses your timeline
reminders.why: Late starts lead to rushed decisions on benefits worth six figures over your lifetime.

reminders.title: Begin Building Your Civilian Network
reminders.brief: Your DD214 won't get you hired — your network will. Start now.
items: Create or update LinkedIn profile
Join veteran networking groups (ACP, MilMentor)
Identify 3-5 mentors in target industry
Attend at least one industry event monthly
reminders.why: Veterans who network 18+ months out have significantly higher placement rates.

reminders.title: Research SkillBridge Opportunities
reminders.brief: SkillBridge = civilian experience during your final months while continuing military compensation and benefits. Duration and approval are service- and paygrade-specific. Published ceilings range from 60–180 days; confirm yours before choosing a start date.
items: Browse SkillBridge employers in the app feed

KNOW YOUR CEILING: Army, Air Force, Space Force, and Marine Corps standard published tiers span 60–120 days; Coast Guard permits up to 180 days; Navy tiers are 90, 120, or 180 days depending on paygrade and qualifying program. Use your current service instruction or MyNavyHR SkillBridge page to confirm your maximum days and approval authority before setting a start date.
Identify 3-5 target companies

NEW (JUN 2026): services are directed to APPROVE SkillBridge requests that support the defense industrial base — shipbuilding, missile defense, aircraft, munitions — denying only for readiness reasons. Targeting a defense employer strengthens your packet
Verify commander support and unit manning
Begin application packet (some need 12+ months lead)
Check mypatriotcareer.mil for defense-sector openings and credentialing resources
reminders.deadline: Applications often due 6-12 months before start
reminders.why: A late packet can make the requested dates impossible to fit before separation. Confirm your service/paygrade ceiling and approval chain before choosing a start date. If your target employer supports the defense industrial base, the approval presumption now works for you — service-level implementation guidance is still rolling out, so confirm with your Transition Center.

reminders.title: Begin Resume Development
reminders.brief: Translating military experience into civilian language takes time. Don't wait.
items: Use MOS Crosswalk to identify civilian job titles
Draft resume with accomplishment-based bullets
Remove ALL military jargon
Get feedback from a civilian hiring manager
reminders.deadline: First draft complete no later than 12 months out
reminders.why: Poorly translated resumes get filtered by ATS before a human ever sees them.

reminders.title: ⚠️ BDD Claim — Prep Now, File at 180 Days
reminders.brief: If eligible, file through BDD during the 180–90-day window. If VA grants direct service connection, the effective date may be as early as the day after separation.
items: Gather all medical records and Line of Duty (LOD) determinations
Schedule pre-claim consultation with VSO (DAV, VFW, American Legion)
Request complete STRs now — medical, dental, mental health (separately). Do not file until 180 days out
Get buddy statements for service-connected conditions
Schedule remaining medical appointments for documentation
reminders.deadline: File between 180 and 90 days before separation
reminders.why: BDD gives VA time to develop the claim before separation. If fewer than 90 days remain, file a standard pre-discharge claim instead.

reminders.title: ⚠️ State Tax Residency — Legal RESIDENCE Matters
reminders.brief: Your state of LEGAL RESIDENCE (not Home of Record) determines state tax on retired pay. $5K-$15K+/year impact.
items: No state income tax: AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY
Most other states fully exempt military retired pay — check YOUR state's current status in the Tax Intel tab
Establish legal residency BEFORE separation
MSRRA allows spouses same state for tax
reminders.deadline: Establish residency before separation date
reminders.why: Wrong state costs retirees thousands annually for life.

reminders.title: ⚠️ Survivor Benefit Plan (SBP) — IRREVOCABLE
reminders.brief: Retirees must elect or decline SBP. Nearly IRREVOCABLE. Provides up to 55% of retired pay to survivors.
items: SBP costs 6.5% of retired pay for spouse
Calculate breakeven vs commercial life insurance
Spouse concurrence required to decline
SBP is inflation-adjusted; commercial is not
Consider DIC offset and SBP-DIC interaction
reminders.deadline: Election must be made before retirement
reminders.why: Declining and dying without adequate life insurance leaves your family exposed. Cannot be undone.

reminders.title: Register for an RSO Retirement Planning Seminar (Guard/Reserve)
reminders.brief: If you are headed for the Retired Reserve, the Retirement Services Office runs free Retirement Planning Seminars that cover SBP elections, gray-area status, and the age 60 retired pay application. Go before you sign anything.
items: Find the next seminar on the Army-wide calendar: soldierforlife.army.mil/Retirement/Events
Pull your retirement points statement and bring it
Write down your SBP questions in advance. This decision follows you for decades
reminders.deadline: Before your transfer to the Retired Reserve
reminders.why: SBP and retired pay decisions made blind at the end cost money for decades. The seminar is free and the counselors do this every day.

reminders.title: TSP Strategy & Rollover Planning
reminders.brief: TSP expense ratios (~0.05%) are among the lowest anywhere. Don't roll over blindly.
items: Review current allocation and rebalance
Options: leave in TSP, rollover to IRA, or new 401(k)
TSP expense ratio ~0.05% vs typical civilian 0.5-1.5%
Use DIRECT rollover to avoid 20% withholding
Consider Roth conversion if lower tax bracket post-sep
reminders.deadline: Have plan before separation
reminders.why: Indirect rollovers trigger 20% withholding and potential early withdrawal penalties.

reminders.title: SkillBridge Service-Rule Check — T-365
reminders.brief: Begin service-specific SkillBridge planning. Marines may initiate NCMIS applications up to 365 days before EAS; other services use their own processes and timelines.
items: Confirm your rank category and maximum program days under your service instruction
Marines: initiate application in NCMIS
Identify the approval authority assigned to your service and paygrade under current guidance; brief your chain now.
Lock target employer list to 3–5 and open conversations
Map PTDY/PTAD + terminal leave inside your category ceiling
reminders.deadline: Confirm the service-specific application timeline, maximum days, and approval authority before setting a requested start date.
reminders.why: Your authorized ceiling and approval authority determine whether the requested dates can fit before separation; confirm both before routing the packet.

reminders.title: Security Clearance Monetization
reminders.brief: Secret or TS/SCI typically adds $10K-$30K+ to salary offers — but only if you use it before it lapses.
items: Verify clearance status with SSO/FSO
Target cleared positions in defense/intel/contracting
Booz Allen, SAIC, Leidos, Raytheon recruit cleared vets
Clearance stays active 24 months post-sep if no break
reminders.deadline: 24 months post-sep for most clearances
reminders.why: A lapsed TS/SCI costs $50K+ and 12-18 months to reinvestigate. Use it or lose it.

reminders.title: ⚠️ BDD Window OPEN — Closes at 90 Days
reminders.brief: The BDD window runs from 180 to 90 days before separation. At 90 days, BDD closes; the standard pre-discharge claim path remains available.
items: File BDD claim on VA.gov IMMEDIATELY
Ensure all C&P exams scheduled
Submit remaining buddy statements
Confirm VSO submitted your package
reminders.deadline: Closes 90 days before separation — HARD DEADLINE
reminders.why: Missing BDD removes that pre-discharge processing path, not the ability to file a disability claim.

reminders.title: Post-Separation Housing Plan
reminders.brief: Where are you living after ETS? BAH is going away.
items: Research housing costs in target area
VA Home Loan: $0 down, no PMI — use it
Get pre-approved before separation (active duty income helps)
If renting, budget first/last/deposit without BAH
reminders.deadline: Housing secured no later than 60 days before ETS
reminders.why: Separating without housing leads to financial stress and family strain.

reminders.title: GI Bill & Education Planning
reminders.brief: If eligible, evaluate VR&E (Chapter 31) before the GI Bill (Chapter 33) — it can preserve months of entitlement.
items: Apply to target schools
Apply for GI Bill COE on VA.gov
If eligible: evaluate VR&E (Ch.31) BEFORE using GI Bill
Research Yellow Ribbon programs
Factor in BAH-equivalent MHA (based on school zip)
reminders.deadline: School applications 6+ months before start
reminders.why: VR&E does not count against your 36 GI Bill months — sequencing right can preserve benefits worth tens of thousands.

reminders.title: SkillBridge Execution Check — T-150
reminders.brief: If your packet is not APPROVED yet, you are in the danger zone. Service/paygrade ceilings are 60, 90, 120, or 180 days — confirm yours before fixing a start date.
items: Packet approved? If not: get status from your SkillBridge coordinator TODAY
Count backward: program days + terminal leave must fit before separation date
Ceiling check: compare your service/paygrade maximum with the days remaining before separation and your requested program dates.

No packet at all? Ask your service SkillBridge office whether a shorter program can fit your remaining authorized window; if the employer supports the defense industrial base, apply the JUN 2026 approval presumption subject to readiness.
Fallback: pivot to employer-direct hiring pipelines in the app feed
reminders.deadline: Before the requested start date; approval and all program days must fit before separation.
reminders.why: A 180-day ceiling does not apply to every service/paygrade category. Confirm your ceiling before setting the start date.

reminders.title: Final Medical & Dental
reminders.brief: Use your remaining time in service to complete medical and dental care and collect your records.
items: Schedule dental cleaning and procedures
Vision exam and updated prescription
Complete all pending referrals
Request complete medical and dental records
Schedule separation physical
Document current conditions for a potential VA claim
reminders.deadline: Complete required separation health steps before your service's deadline
reminders.why: VA evaluates each claimed condition using the evidence of record. Keep your service treatment records current and complete.

reminders.title: DD214 Worksheet Review
reminders.brief: Your DD214 is the most important document of your military career. Errors take months to correct.
items: Review worksheet with S-1/admin/personnel office
Verify dates, rank, MOS, awards, deployments
Ensure all schools and qualifications listed
Verify separation code and RE code
Dispute BEFORE signing — correcting after is a nightmare
reminders.deadline: Review as soon as generated — typically 90 days before ETS
reminders.why: Errors affect VA benefits, employment, and veterans preference for life.

reminders.title: Register for VA Healthcare
reminders.brief: Apply now so coverage is ready on Day 1.
items: Apply at VA.gov or nearest VA medical center
Understand your Priority Group
Locate nearest VAMC and CBOC
TAMP (if you qualify): 180 days TRICARE after separation
Retirees: review TRICARE Retired options
reminders.deadline: Apply before separation for seamless coverage
reminders.why: TAMP (when it applies) only lasts 180 days. Gaps put your family at risk.

reminders.title: Final Financial Readiness Check
reminders.brief: Do you have 3-6 months saved? Know when the money stops.
items: Verify final pay date and amount with finance
Calculate terminal leave (sell back vs take leave)
Ensure 3-6 months emergency fund accessible
Budget first 90 days without military pay
Cancel military-specific allotments
File unemployment on Day 1 — most separating members qualify (varies by state)
reminders.deadline: No later than 60 days before ETS
reminders.why: 35% of veterans report financial hardship in Year 1. Don't be a statistic.

reminders.title: Final Out-Processing & Life Admin
reminders.brief: You're on the objective. Execute with discipline.
items: Complete TAP Capstone
USPS mail forwarding
Update banks, credit cards, insurance
Obtain 10+ certified DD214 copies
Verify final LES
Letter of service for employment verification
Download all military email contacts
reminders.deadline: All items complete before ETS
reminders.why: Loose ends after separation become 10x harder without base access.

reminders.title: ⚠️ FEDVIP Dental/Vision Window OPEN (Retirees)
reminders.brief: Your FEDVIP enrollment window opens 31 days before your retirement date. Enrollment is not automatic.
items: Enroll BEFORE your retirement date to avoid a dental coverage gap
Window: 31 days before retirement date through 60 days after
Vision coverage requires enrollment in a TRICARE health plan
Gray area reservists under age 60 are also eligible
Miss the window and you wait for the next Federal Benefits Open Season
Enroll at BENEFEDS.gov or 1-877-888-3337
reminders.deadline: 60 days after retirement date — HARD DEADLINE
reminders.why: Active duty dental ends at retirement. FEDVIP replaced the TRICARE Retiree Dental Program — no dental coverage is waiting on the other side unless you enroll.

reminders.title: Entering the Gray Area — Establish Your DFAS Future Retiree Account
reminders.brief: Guard/Reserve with 20 good years: your link to retired pay runs through a myPay account most members never set up.
items: Establish your Future Retiree myPay account at mypay.dfas.mil — easier now while your login is active
Keep contact info current in THREE systems: DFAS, DEERS, and your branch — updates do not transfer between them
DFAS sends a retired pay prompt at age 59 ONLY if your account has a current email on file
Retired pay is NOT automatic — apply through your service (Army: HRC Gray Area Retirements Branch, not DFAS) 9 months to 90 days before eligibility age
Gray area retains commissary, exchange, MWR access, and select TRICARE plans
reminders.deadline: Set up before losing routine myPay access
reminders.why: Members who fall off the radar in the gray area face serious delays when retired pay eligibility arrives.

reminders.title: SEPARATION DAY — Verify Everything
reminders.brief: Before you drive off for the last time, make sure your paperwork is squared away.
items: VERIFY DD214 — read every line before signing
Obtain multiple certified copies
Verify sep code, RE code, characterization
Secure medical and dental records
reminders.deadline: TODAY
reminders.why: Your DD214 is your new birth certificate. Get it right.

reminders.title: First 30 Days — File Unemployment & Activate Benefits
reminders.brief: Several critical windows open at separation and close fast.
items: File unemployment IMMEDIATELY (DD214 = proof)
Register for VA healthcare if not done
Monitor VA.gov for C&P exam schedule
Apply veteran's preference (SF-15)
Veteran driver's license designation
reminders.deadline: State unemployment deadlines start from sep date
reminders.why: Unemployment (UCX) can mean roughly $1,300-$2,200/month of bridge income depending on your state. Don't leave it on the table.

reminders.title: FEDVIP Backstop — 30 Days Left on the Window (Retirees)
reminders.brief: If you retired without enrolling in FEDVIP dental/vision, the 60-day window is half gone.
items: Enroll now at BENEFEDS.gov — after day 60 the next opportunity is Federal Benefits Open Season (Nov–Dec)
Retiree TRICARE enrollment is also NOT automatic — retirement is a Qualifying Life Event with a 90-day enrollment period at tricare.mil
reminders.deadline: Day 60 after retirement date (FEDVIP); day 90 (TRICARE QLE)
reminders.why: Two separate non-automatic enrollments — FEDVIP and retiree TRICARE — expire in your first 90 days out. Both are routinely missed.

reminders.title: ⚠️ SGLI to VGLI — The Clock Is Running
reminders.brief: Free SGLI coverage ends 120 days after separation. VGLI with NO health exam is available only through day 240.
items: Day 0-120: SGLI continues free — compare VGLI vs commercial term rates NOW
Day 0-240: VGLI guaranteed acceptance, no medical exam
Day 241-485: VGLI still possible but medical evidence required — can be denied
Day 486+: VGLI window closed permanently
If service-connected conditions exist, VGLI may be your only option
Apply at myvgli.prudential.com or 1-800-419-1473
reminders.deadline: 240 days post-separation for no-exam VGLI — HARD DEADLINE
reminders.why: After day 240 you must prove good health. PTSD, sleep apnea, or musculoskeletal conditions can disqualify you on the civilian market.

reminders.title: TAMP Ending — Healthcare Decision
reminders.brief: 180-day TAMP TRICARE is ending. You need a plan.
items: VA-rated: verify enrollment and Priority Group
Employed: enroll in employer healthcare
Retiring: TRICARE Retired (Prime, Select, For Life at 65)
Otherwise: ACA marketplace (HealthCare.gov)
VA doesn't cover routine dental unless 100%
reminders.deadline: 180 days post-separation
reminders.why: One ER visit without coverage averages $2,200+.

reminders.title: One-Year AAR — Benefits & Career
reminders.brief: You've been out a year. Time for an honest after-action review.
items: Review VA claim — file supplemental if needed
Career at target level and salary?
If underemployed, use VET HUB tools
Check VR&E (Ch.31) eligibility
Rebalance TSP/retirement accounts
reminders.deadline: Self-imposed 12-month AAR
reminders.why: Veterans who don't course-correct in Year 1 are more likely to stay underemployed.

reminders.title: Verify Your ILER Exposure Record
reminders.brief: FY26 NDAA codified the Individual Longitudinal Exposure Record. Your toxic exposure history now flows directly to the VA — verify it while you can still fix it.
items: Pull your ILER through milConnect
Cross-check deployments, burn pit locations, and known exposure events
Report gaps or errors through your medical channel NOW — corrections are 10x harder after DD214
Gather buddy statements for any exposure not yet documented
reminders.deadline: Before separation — while records can still be corrected in uniform
reminders.why: The VA now receives your complete exposure history up front to speed toxic-exposure claims. Errors or gaps in that record follow you into the claims process.

reminders.title: New TAP Rules In Effect — FY26 NDAA
reminders.brief: Congress overhauled TAP in December 2025. Know what changed and use it.
items: Pre-separation counseling now delivered in person whenever possible — request it
DoD now tracks WHEN you start TAP — late starts are visible to your command
Financial counseling expanded: individualized guidance on loans and debt management
Spouses: TAP pilot program launching at 5 installations — ask your Transition Center
Guard/Reserve: waiver provision allows TAP every 3 years unless circumstances changed
reminders.deadline: Statutory TAP start remains NLT 365 days before separation
reminders.why: Only about half of transitioning service members start TAP on time. Congress added these accountability measures because late starts cost real money in missed benefits.

reminders.title: GI Bill — Check for 48 Months of Entitlement
reminders.brief: Rudisill (2024) and Perkins (2026) court rulings: served two qualifying periods? You may rate up to 48 months of combined education benefits — not 36.
items: Pull your education benefits eligibility letter on VA.gov
Identify qualifying periods: one under Montgomery GI Bill, one under Post-9/11
If previously capped at 36 months, request a review — VA updated its awarding process
Factor a potential extra 12 months into your education and VR&E plan
reminders.deadline: Verify before locking in your education plan
reminders.why: Twelve additional months can mean a full year of tuition plus BAH. VA updated its awarding process. Check your eligibility on VA.gov.

reminders.title: TRICARE 2026 — Costs and Access Changed
reminders.brief: Pharmacy copays rose 1 JAN 2026 and access rules shifted. Budget your post-separation healthcare with current numbers.
items: Retail (30-day): $16 generic / $48 brand-name
Home delivery (90-day): $14 generic / $44 brand / $85 non-formulary
Military pharmacies remain $0 for all covered medications
Prime travel benefit threshold for specialty care reduced from 100 to 75 miles for active-duty family members (retirees remain at 100 miles)
TRICARE Open Season runs Nov-Dec annually — plan changes happen then or at a Qualifying Life Event
reminders.deadline: Open Season window if changing plans
reminders.why: Separation IS a Qualifying Life Event — but knowing 2026 costs before you choose between TAMP, CHCBP, employer coverage, or VA care prevents budget surprises.

reminders.title: VET TEC 2.0 — Tech Training Is Back
reminders.brief: The VA's high-tech training program returned under the Dole Act. Applications opened JUN 2026 and are open now. Capped at 4,000 paid participants per fiscal year — slots will go fast.
items: Eligible: a veteran discharged other than dishonorable, OR a service member within 180 days of separating — and EITHER path also requires 36+ months of active duty and being under 62 when VA approves your application
Covers tuition, monthly housing allowance, and books through VA-approved providers
Fields: computer programming, computer software, data processing, information sciences, media application
CHANGED FROM THE ORIGINAL: if you have remaining GI Bill or DEA entitlement, VET TEC 2.0 now charges 1 month of entitlement per month of full-time training — factor this into your education plan
Preferred providers must place 70% of graduates in-field within 180 days or refund tuition to VA
Apply at VA.gov — VA Form 22-10297
reminders.deadline: Annual cap of 4,000 participants — apply early in the fiscal year
reminders.why: Accelerated tech training with housing allowance, without committing to a degree program. But the entitlement charge means the old 'doesn't touch your GI Bill' advice no longer applies — verify your math first.

reminders.title: Digital GI Bill — Verify Your Payments
reminders.brief: The VA's $2.3B Digital GI Bill system has documented payment failures under active congressional oversight. Trust but verify.
items: Confirm your School Certifying Official submitted your enrollment certification
Verify your Certificate of Eligibility is on file with the school
Monitor your first BAH payment date — do not assume it processed
Payment problems: call the VA Education Call Center at 1-888-442-4551 immediately
reminders.deadline: Before your first tuition deadline and rent payment
reminders.why: Automation now handles most education claims, but documented failures have left student veterans waiting on housing payments. Your rent does not wait for a system fix.

milestones.title: Initial Planning & Medical Documentation

tasks.text: Attend Initial TAP briefing
Complete Individual Transition Plan (ITP) with commander
Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record.
Follow up on current conditions, referrals, and specialist appointments; keep your service treatment records current

Research VR&E (Chapter 31) — vocational rehab benefits at 10%+ disability rating (priority at 20%+). It interacts with your GI Bill and the choice matters — understand both before you elect. Ask a VSO
Review military service records for accuracy (OMPF)
Research post-separation state: income tax, property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet benefits
Begin networking — LinkedIn profile, veteran groups, mentors
Get professional headshot — Portraits for Patriots offers FREE headshots for military (see Resources → TAP+)

milestones.reminder: Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record. Also: research VR&E (Ch. 31) — if you qualify, understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you choose, because the election affects both.

milestones.title: Benefits, Claims & Medical Follow-Up

tasks.text: Continue medical documentation — follow up on ALL referrals and specialist appointments
Keep service treatment records current; follow up on active referrals and document current conditions
If eligible: apply for VR&E (Chapter 31) NOW — vocational rehab for service-connected veterans. Understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you elect — the choice matters
Research VA disability claim process and BDD program (opens at 180 days)
Attend TAP workshops — not all TAPs are equal, supplement with outside resources (see Resources → TAP+)
Research GI Bill eligibility and transfer options — remember VR&E comes FIRST if eligible
Verify SGLI to VGLI conversion timeline

milestones.reminder: BDD opens at 180 days. Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA evaluates each claimed condition using the evidence of record. Consider VR&E (Ch. 31) before spending GI Bill months if you qualify — the two interact and the election matters. Ask a VSO which fits your plan.

milestones.title: Career Targeting & Gap Analysis

tasks.text: Run MOS through O*NET Crosswalk — identify top 3 civilian job matches (Pathway tab)
Complete Gap Analysis — compare your skills to target job requirements (Pathway → Step 2)
Choose your path: college degree, certs/trades, or SkillBridge (Pathway → Step 3)
Research certs & credentials on DOD COOL — many are FREE on active duty
Map your income stack: VA comp + GI Bill BAH + work programs (Pathway → Step 4)
Apply through your service-specific SkillBridge or Career Skills Program process after confirming your maximum days and approval authority.
Apply for ACP mentorship — FREE year-long 1-on-1 with Fortune 500 professionals (acp-usa.org)
Register on 50 Strong — FREE on-demand mentoring, employer connects, and job board (50-strong.us)
Contact vet-ready employers with gap closure programs (Pathway → Step 5)

milestones.reminder: Run your crosswalk. Run your gap analysis. Choose your path. GET A MENTOR NOW — ACP and 50 Strong are free and connect you with civilians who've hired vets. One conversation can change your trajectory.

milestones.title: BDD Filing & Financial Operations

tasks.text: SUBMIT BDD claim (Benefits Delivery at Discharge) — 180-90 day window is NOW
Be available for VA C&P exams within 45 days of filing
Keep service treatment records current and complete before separation
Build post-separation budget (no BAH/BAS)
Determine state of residence for tax purposes
Research VA home loan pre-approval
Open/verify civilian bank accounts
Review TSP rollover options
Secure housing at post-separation location

milestones.reminder: BDD WINDOW IS OPEN. Submit your claim NOW (180-90 days pre-sep). Be available for VA exams within 45 days of filing. Keep your service treatment records current and complete.

milestones.title: Administrative & Legal Closeout

tasks.text: Complete DD214 worksheet — verify every line
Schedule separation physical (VA C&P exam may satisfy this — check with medical)
Verify all awards, decorations, schools on record
Set up VA healthcare enrollment
Update DEERS for dependents
Finalize SBP elections (if retiring)

milestones.reminder: Your DD214 is your most important document. Verify every entry. Errors are costly.

milestones.title: Final Preparations & Outprocessing

tasks.text: Complete installation outprocessing checklist
Turn in all CIF/IIF (unit supply) and organizational equipment
Obtain 10+ certified copies of DD214
Verify final pay / leave sellback
Set up TRICARE transition (TAMP if eligible / CHCBP)
Confirm VA disability rating status

milestones.reminder: Get 10+ certified copies of your DD214. You will need them for everything.

milestones.title: First 90 Days as a Veteran

tasks.text: Register with VA healthcare system
Apply for state veteran benefits — property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet bonuses
File for unemployment (UCX) if applicable
Connect with local veteran service organizations
Verify GI Bill enrollment / housing allowance
Establish primary care provider
Get your America the Beautiful Pass — FREE National Parks & Federal Lands access for all veterans (see Vet Perks tab)
Get veteran designation on driver's license — free in most states, proves status without carrying DD214
Join a veteran community — Team RWB, The Mission Continues, Team Rubicon, Next 18 (free golf & wellness camps), local VFW or American Legion post. Don't isolate.
Read the MINDSET tab — The Drop hits at months 1-3. Know the signs. Build structure. Ask for help if you need it.

milestones.reminder: You earned these benefits. Don't leave anything on the table. And be ready for The Drop — the loss of identity, structure, and purpose hits harder than anyone warns you. Build your new routine, connect with other vets, and don't isolate. See Resources → Mindset.

milestones.title: Initial Planning & Medical Documentation

tasks.text: Attend Initial TAP briefing
Complete Individual Transition Plan (ITP) with commander
Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record.
Follow up on current conditions, referrals, and specialist appointments; keep your service treatment records current

Research VR&E (Chapter 31) — vocational rehab benefits at 10%+ disability rating (priority at 20%+). It interacts with your GI Bill and the choice matters — understand both before you elect. Ask a VSO
Review military service records for accuracy (OMPF)
Research post-separation state: income tax, property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet benefits
Begin networking — LinkedIn profile, veteran groups, mentors
Get professional headshot — Portraits for Patriots offers FREE headshots for military (see Resources → TAP+)

milestones.reminder: Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record. Also: research VR&E (Ch. 31) — if you qualify, understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you choose, because the election affects both.

milestones.title: Benefits, Claims & Medical Follow-Up

tasks.text: Continue medical documentation — follow up on ALL referrals and specialist appointments
Keep service treatment records current; follow up on active referrals and document current conditions
If eligible: apply for VR&E (Chapter 31) NOW — vocational rehab for service-connected veterans. Understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you elect — the choice matters
Research VA disability claim process and BDD program (opens at 180 days)
Attend TAP workshops — not all TAPs are equal, supplement with outside resources (see Resources → TAP+)
Research GI Bill eligibility and transfer options — remember VR&E comes FIRST if eligible
Verify SGLI to VGLI conversion timeline

milestones.reminder: BDD opens at 180 days. Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA evaluates each claimed condition using the evidence of record. Consider VR&E (Ch. 31) before spending GI Bill months if you qualify — the two interact and the election matters. Ask a VSO which fits your plan.

milestones.title: Career Targeting & Gap Analysis

tasks.text: Run MOS through O*NET Crosswalk — identify top 3 civilian job matches (Pathway tab)
Complete Gap Analysis — compare your skills to target job requirements (Pathway → Step 2)
Choose your path: college degree, certs/trades, or SkillBridge (Pathway → Step 3)
Research certs & credentials on DOD COOL — many are FREE on active duty
Map your income stack: VA comp + GI Bill BAH + work programs (Pathway → Step 4)
Apply through your service-specific SkillBridge or Career Skills Program process after confirming your maximum days and approval authority.
Apply for ACP mentorship — FREE year-long 1-on-1 with Fortune 500 professionals (acp-usa.org)
Register on 50 Strong — FREE on-demand mentoring, employer connects, and job board (50-strong.us)
Contact vet-ready employers with gap closure programs (Pathway → Step 5)

milestones.reminder: Run your crosswalk. Run your gap analysis. Choose your path. GET A MENTOR NOW — ACP and 50 Strong are free and connect you with civilians who've hired vets. One conversation can change your trajectory.

milestones.title: BDD Filing & Financial Operations

tasks.text: SUBMIT BDD claim (Benefits Delivery at Discharge) — 180-90 day window is NOW
Be available for VA C&P exams within 45 days of filing
Keep service treatment records current and complete before separation
Build post-separation budget (no BAH/BAS)
Determine state of residence for tax purposes
Research VA home loan pre-approval
Open/verify civilian bank accounts
Review TSP rollover options
Secure housing at post-separation location

milestones.reminder: BDD WINDOW IS OPEN. Submit your claim NOW (180-90 days pre-sep). Be available for VA exams within 45 days of filing. Keep your service treatment records current and complete.

milestones.title: Administrative & Legal Closeout

tasks.text: Complete DD214 worksheet — verify every line
Schedule separation physical (VA C&P exam may satisfy this — check with medical)
Verify all awards, decorations, schools on record
Set up VA healthcare enrollment
Update DEERS for dependents
Finalize SBP elections (if retiring)

milestones.reminder: Your DD214 is your most important document. Verify every entry. Errors are costly.

milestones.title: Final Preparations & Outprocessing

tasks.text: Complete installation outprocessing checklist
Turn in all CIF/IIF (unit supply) and organizational equipment
Obtain 10+ certified copies of DD214
Verify final pay / leave sellback
Set up TRICARE transition (TAMP if eligible / CHCBP)
Confirm VA disability rating status

milestones.reminder: Get 10+ certified copies of your DD214. You will need them for everything.

milestones.title: First 90 Days as a Veteran

tasks.text: Register with VA healthcare system
Apply for state veteran benefits — property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet bonuses
File for unemployment (UCX) if applicable
Connect with local veteran service organizations
Verify GI Bill enrollment / housing allowance
Establish primary care provider
Get your America the Beautiful Pass — FREE National Parks & Federal Lands access for all veterans (see Vet Perks tab)
Get veteran designation on driver's license — free in most states, proves status without carrying DD214
Join a veteran community — Team RWB, The Mission Continues, Team Rubicon, Next 18 (free golf & wellness camps), local VFW or American Legion post. Don't isolate.
Read the MINDSET tab — The Drop hits at months 1-3. Know the signs. Build structure. Ask for help if you need it.

milestones.reminder: You earned these benefits. Don't leave anything on the table. And be ready for The Drop — the loss of identity, structure, and purpose hits harder than anyone warns you. Build your new routine, connect with other vets, and don't isolate. See Resources → Mindset.

milestones.title: Initial Planning & Medical Documentation

tasks.text: Attend Initial TAP briefing
Complete Individual Transition Plan (ITP) with commander
Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record.
Follow up on current conditions, referrals, and specialist appointments; keep your service treatment records current

Research VR&E (Chapter 31) — vocational rehab benefits at 10%+ disability rating (priority at 20%+). It interacts with your GI Bill and the choice matters — understand both before you elect. Ask a VSO
Review military service records for accuracy (OMPF)
Research post-separation state: income tax, property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet benefits
Begin networking — LinkedIn profile, veteran groups, mentors
Get professional headshot — Portraits for Patriots offers FREE headshots for military (see Resources → TAP+)

milestones.reminder: Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA decides service connection from the evidence of record. Also: research VR&E (Ch. 31) — if you qualify, understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you choose, because the election affects both.

milestones.title: Benefits, Claims & Medical Follow-Up

tasks.text: Continue medical documentation — follow up on ALL referrals and specialist appointments
Keep service treatment records current; follow up on active referrals and document current conditions
If eligible: apply for VR&E (Chapter 31) NOW — vocational rehab for service-connected veterans. Understand how it interacts with your GI Bill before you elect — the choice matters
Research VA disability claim process and BDD program (opens at 180 days)
Attend TAP workshops — not all TAPs are equal, supplement with outside resources (see Resources → TAP+)
Research GI Bill eligibility and transfer options — remember VR&E comes FIRST if eligible
Verify SGLI to VGLI conversion timeline

milestones.reminder: BDD opens at 180 days. Gather service treatment records and document current conditions before filing. VA evaluates each claimed condition using the evidence of record. Consider VR&E (Ch. 31) before spending GI Bill months if you qualify — the two interact and the election matters. Ask a VSO which fits your plan.

milestones.title: Career Targeting & Gap Analysis

tasks.text: Run MOS through O*NET Crosswalk — identify top 3 civilian job matches (Pathway tab)
Complete Gap Analysis — compare your skills to target job requirements (Pathway → Step 2)
Choose your path: college degree, certs/trades, or SkillBridge (Pathway → Step 3)
Research certs & credentials on DOD COOL — many are FREE on active duty
Map your income stack: VA comp + GI Bill BAH + work programs (Pathway → Step 4)
Apply through your service-specific SkillBridge or Career Skills Program process after confirming your maximum days and approval authority.
Apply for ACP mentorship — FREE year-long 1-on-1 with Fortune 500 professionals (acp-usa.org)
Register on 50 Strong — FREE on-demand mentoring, employer connects, and job board (50-strong.us)
Contact vet-ready employers with gap closure programs (Pathway → Step 5)

milestones.reminder: Run your crosswalk. Run your gap analysis. Choose your path. GET A MENTOR NOW — ACP and 50 Strong are free and connect you with civilians who've hired vets. One conversation can change your trajectory.

milestones.title: BDD Filing & Financial Operations

tasks.text: SUBMIT BDD claim (Benefits Delivery at Discharge) — 180-90 day window is NOW
Be available for VA C&P exams within 45 days of filing
Keep service treatment records current and complete before separation
Build post-separation budget (no BAH/BAS)
Determine state of residence for tax purposes
Research VA home loan pre-approval
Open/verify civilian bank accounts
Review TSP rollover options
Secure housing at post-separation location

milestones.reminder: BDD WINDOW IS OPEN. Submit your claim NOW (180-90 days pre-sep). Be available for VA exams within 45 days of filing. Keep your service treatment records current and complete.

milestones.title: Administrative & Legal Closeout

tasks.text: Complete DD214 worksheet — verify every line
Schedule separation physical (VA C&P exam may satisfy this — check with medical)
Verify all awards, decorations, schools on record
Set up VA healthcare enrollment
Update DEERS for dependents
Finalize SBP elections (if retiring)

milestones.reminder: Your DD214 is your most important document. Verify every entry. Errors are costly.

milestones.title: Final Preparations & Outprocessing

tasks.text: Complete installation outprocessing checklist
Turn in all CIF/IIF (unit supply) and organizational equipment
Obtain 10+ certified copies of DD214
Verify final pay / leave sellback
Set up TRICARE transition (TAMP if eligible / CHCBP)
Confirm VA disability rating status

milestones.reminder: Get 10+ certified copies of your DD214. You will need them for everything.

milestones.title: First 90 Days as a Veteran

tasks.text: Register with VA healthcare system
Apply for state veteran benefits — property tax exemptions, vehicle registration discounts, state vet bonuses
File for unemployment (UCX) if applicable
Connect with local veteran service organizations
Verify GI Bill enrollment / housing allowance
Establish primary care provider
Get your America the Beautiful Pass — FREE National Parks & Federal Lands access for all veterans (see Vet Perks tab)
Get veteran designation on driver's license — free in most states, proves status without carrying DD214
Join a veteran community — Team RWB, The Mission Continues, Team Rubicon, Next 18 (free golf & wellness camps), local VFW or American Legion post. Don't isolate.
Read the MINDSET tab — The Drop hits at months 1-3. Know the signs. Build structure. Ask for help if you need it.

milestones.reminder: You earned these benefits. Don't leave anything on the table. And be ready for The Drop — the loss of identity, structure, and purpose hits harder than anyone warns you. Build your new routine, connect with other vets, and don't isolate. See Resources → Mindset.
